data.name: Tiphany
data.gender_notes: Tiphany is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Tiphany is recorded in name-lists as “God's grace, beauty”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tiphany expresses “God's grace, beauty”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tiphany total 39, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
